notes: Platinum-group-metals (PGM) producer, not a gold/silver miner. Formerly Anglo American Platinum Limited; demerged from Anglo American plc late May 2025 and renamed Valterra Platinum; secondary listing on LSE (VALT). FY2025 (ended 31 Dec 2025): metal-in-concentrate PGM production 3.2 Moz; refined PGM production 3.4 Moz; PGM sales 3.4-3.5 Moz; all-in sustaining cost US$987/3E oz; revenue R116.3B; adjusted EBITDA R33.4B; mining EBITDA margin 38%; net cash R11.5B; total dividend R45.00/share; CEO Craig Miller. 2026 guidance: M&C and refined PGM production 3.0-3.4 Moz. Included in spreadsheet because held by the Sprott GBUG ETF (Dec 2025 factsheet: 2.11%), but contributes no gold/silver mine rows.
